chain.label: Flight crew fatigue late in a long duty day near their normal bedtime
chain.trigger: the captain and the first officer had been continuously awake for at least 16 hours...at a time of night when they would have normally been asleep

chain.label: Severe thunderstorm line moved into the Little Rock airport area during the approach
chain.trigger: severe thunderstorms and their associated hazards to flight operations had moved into the airport area

chain.label: Controller issued windshear alerts as the storm's leading edge reached the airport
chain.trigger: the controller provided the flight crew with the second of the two windshear alerts...wind was 350º at 32 knots with gusts to 45 knots

caused_by.evidence: a thunderstorm located northwest of the airport was moving through the area

chain.label: Reported crosswind component exceeded American's maximum landing crosswind limit
chain.trigger: the latest winds reported by the controller resulted in a crosswind component of 23 knots for the steady-state wind and 34 knots for the gusting wind

caused_by.evidence: wind was 350º at 30 knots gusting to 45 knots

chain.label: Heavy rain sharply reduced visibility and RVR at the airport during final approach
chain.trigger: heavy rain was falling at the airport, visibility was less than 1 mile, and the runway visual range (RVR) for runway 4R was 3,000 feet

caused_by.evidence: heavy rain was falling at the airport

chain.label: Flight crew failed to discontinue the approach despite the approaching severe thunderstorm, exceeded crosswind limit, and worsening visibility
chain.trigger: the flight crew's failure to discontinue the approach when severe thunderstorms and their associated hazards to flight operations had moved into the airport area

caused_by.evidence: severe thunderstorms and their associated hazards to flight operations had moved into the airport area
continuation of the approach to a landing when the company's maximum crosswind component was exceeded
impaired performance resulting from fatigue and the situational stress associated with the intent to land

chain.label: Flight crew rushed through the Before Landing checklist, leaving the spoiler handle unarmed and never manually deploying the spoilers
chain.trigger: there is no CVR evidence...that either pilot had armed the spoiler lever...the captain failed to manually extend the spoilers when they did not deploy

caused_by.evidence: the flight crew's failure to adequately prepare for the approach and the rapidly deteriorating weather conditions

chain.label: Captain applied reverse thrust well above the 1.3 EPR limit for wet-runway operations
chain.trigger: reverse thrust exceeded 1.3 EPR several times during flight 1420's landing sequence...settings of 1.89 and 1.98 reverse EPR were applied

caused_by.evidence: the pilots' workload associated with attempting to maintain directional control of the airplane on the runway may have prevented them from detecting that the spoilers had not automatically deployed

chain.label: Airplane lost directional control on the runway, drifting up to 16° from the direction of travel
chain.trigger: flight 1420's substantial drift angle while on the runway (as much as 16º both to the right and the left of the direction of travel) was evidence of a directional control problem

caused_by.evidence: the lack of spoiler deployment led directly to the flight crew's problems in stopping the airplane within the remaining available runway length and maintaining directional control of the airplane on the runway
the use of reverse thrust at levels greater than 1.3 EPR significantly reduced the effectiveness of the airplane's rudder and vertical stabilizer and resulted in further directional control problems
a 20- to 25-knot left-to-right crosswind component during the landing

chain.label: Airplane overran the departure end of runway 4R
chain.trigger: flight 1420 departed the end of runway 4R sliding to the left...at a calculated speed of 97 knots

caused_by.evidence: the calculated ground trajectory indicated that the flight 1420 airplane departed runway 4R at about 97 knots

chain.label: Airplane collided with the runway 22L approach lighting system support structure beyond the runway
chain.trigger: collided with the structure supporting the runway 22L approach lighting system

caused_by.evidence: After departing the end of the runway, the airplane struck several tubes...and collided with the structure supporting the runway 22L approach lighting system

chain.label: Captain and 10 passengers killed; many others seriously or minorly injured in impact and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: The captain and 10 passengers were killed; the first officer, the flight attendants, and 105 passengers received serious or minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: the airplane's collision with the nonfrangible approach lighting system was the direct cause of the fatal blunt force trauma injuries sustained by the captain and the passengers
